# MyLactest

> Free lactate threshold analysis for coaches and endurance athletes. Turn field test data into aerobic and anaerobic thresholds plus 5 training zones in seconds.

MyLactest is a web app that calculates lactate thresholds (LT1/AeT and LT2/AnT) from a running, cycling or rowing step test. It produces a full lactate curve, training zones for pace and heart rate, and a coach-ready report — all on a phone, at the track, with no lab required. The service is completely free.
